title: Bay Play
specs: 3,000 square foot custom indoor playground with slides, zip lines, and toddler area
Two-story ninja warrior course with obstacles for different ages
Bouldering wall with large air bag for safe landings
Arcade with classic and new games and redemption prizes
All guests must fill out a waiver prior to arrival
All guests must wear Bay Play Grip Socks provided by the facility
Climbing walls require participants to weigh at least 40 pounds and less than 300 pounds
All guests under 16 must be accompanied by an adult
Party rooms or tables reserved for 45 minutes, plus approx. 2 hours playtime before seating
Guest of honor allowed 2 chaperones; each participant allowed 1 chaperone

blurb: Guests play in a 3,000 square foot custom indoor playground with slides, zip lines, and a toddler area. Additional attractions include a two-story ninja warrior course, bouldering wall with air bag, climbing walls, and an arcade. Birthday parties include reserved rooms or tables, pizza, juice boxes, and game cards.
extraNote: No outside food or drink allowed except cake or cupcakes for parties and small snacks for day visits · Additional non-participating chaperones are charged $5 each · Day passes do not allow re-entry once guest leaves
